title: SHAPE DXF style-name retained owner
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the parsed DXF SHAPE group-2 style/glyph name to its entity owner lease
Clear the parser-owned value and byte counter on reset
Keep SHX resource lookup and glyph/file identity semantics outside this slice

implementation.summary: DRW_Shape::parseCode now passes group 2 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with a dedicated retained-byte counter. resetDwgState clears m_styleName and its counter; the class's implicit copy/assignment preserve the counter and shared base lease. Generated ASCII controls find the minimum accepted cap for OLD-to-GLYPH1 and verify exact-cap success, one-byte-under refusal preserving the prior value, copy/assignment lifetime, and final reset release.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_Shape layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

commands: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md

assessment.claim: The selected parser-owned SHAPE group-2 string is charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget, follows copied model values, and is released on reset. The one-byte-under test stops before parsing the replacement value and preserves the prior name; it does not prove the field helper itself was the first denied reservation. No process RSS/capacity, SHX lookup, glyph semantics, or native CAD claim follows.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII direct-parser controls verify minimum-cap discovery, exact-cap success, one-byte-under no-replacement, copy construction/assignment, sibling reset, and final release. The owning hardening CTest passes.
assessment.limitations: No complete DXF read/callback stream, persistent/external drawing, peer parser, native CAD application, full suite, allocation benchmark, or support/J promotion was used.
